name: Embraer Phenom 100
summary: Embraer's entry-level very light jet, flown by owner-pilots, flight schools and air-taxi operators.

engines: Two Pratt & Whitney Canada PW617F turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Short, chubby fuselage with very large rounded-rectangle windows
Smoothly curved nose flowing into a large wraparound windscreen
tail: T-tail with a swept fin and swept horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Very large windows on a short, chubby very light twinjet
T-tail on top of a swept fin

confusedWith.howToTell: The Phenom 100 has a T-tail and big windows; the Mustang's tailplane sits low on the tail cone and its windows are small.
The Phenom 100 is shorter with fewer windows and plain wingtips; the Phenom 300 has winglets and a longer fuselage.
The Phenom 100's engines are on the rear fuselage; the HondaJet's are on pylons above the wings.
The Phenom 100 has larger windows and a slightly swept wing; the CJ/M2 has small windows and a straight wing.
The Eclipse 500 is much smaller, with a low-set tailplane and bulbous wingtip pods; the Phenom 100 has a T-tail and a longer cabin.
